fields.text: Upload a cluttered scene still; SAM 3 (`sam3-image`) isolates a named object or region from a text prompt. Size auto, $0.005/image. First-click Isolate names the matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron in a cluttered courier desk or wet neon alley — this repo has no committed scene still, so upload that photo or any scene that contains the named object. This is text-selected isolate, not full background removal (use Product cutout / BiRefNet V2 for knocking out the whole background). Inspect the native SAM 3 isolate for the named object; Export preview is a local 1024 fit only.
the matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with one electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron
